[[Iron Island]] }} '''Double Trouble with Dialga and Palkia V''' (Japanese: '''VS ディアルガ&パルキアV''' ''VS Dialga & Palkia V''), titled '''VS Dialga & Palkia V''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 415th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 78th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}. It is subtitled '''Complete and Incomplete''' (Japanese: '''完全と不完全''' ''Perfection and Imperfection'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Perfection and Imperfection''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Pearl}}, {{adv|Platinum}}, {{adv|Diamond}}, and [[Cynthia]] stare in shock as reality begins to warp around them, surrounding them in different settings. Meanwhile at the [[Sinnoh]] Police Station, a {{tc|Police Officer}} tries to interrogate the two {{tc|Scientist}}s who were [[PS362|following orders to block off Lake Valor]], but can't get any answers about [[Team Galactic]] from them. When he exits into the hallway, he sees {{adv|Looker}} and his {{TP|Looker|Croagunk}} and updates them on the interrogation. Looker tells him not to worry, and asks his Croagunk to keep watch as he steps outside. Leaning by the station, Looker notices [[Dr. Footstep]], who is waiting for the interrogation to end so he can ask the two Scientists if he can record the [[footprint]]s of their Pokémon. Suddenly, Dr. Footstep finds himself at [[Spear Pillar]], where space is warping all around him. Both time and space continue to distort all over Sinnoh, affecting everyone in the region. Diamond and the others watch [[Cyrus]] in fear as he speaks of the world's imperfections. Cyrus declares that the only way to fix these imperfections is to destroy the world and recreate it entirely. He explains that {{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Dialga}} and {{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Palkia}}'s combined power will create a core—a seed from which the new world will grow. Suddenly, the unconscious [[Gym Leader]]s begin to drift upward toward the hole in the sky. Diamond, Pearl, and Platinum send out their Pokémon to desperately try to hold them back. Diamond sends out [[Fantina]]'s {{TP|Fantina|Drifblim}} to protect her, reuniting the two. The young {{pkmn|Trainer}}s begin to lose their grip on the Gym Leaders, causing Diamond to declare that he's going to close up the hole in the sky. Diamond tries to have {{DL|Diamond (Adventures)|Moo}} use a {{m|Blizzard}} attack on the hole, but it is only absorbed. He decides that the next step is to jump into the hole and close it from the other side. Pearl and Platinum both scream as Diamond and Moo charge for it. Right as Diamond is about to enter it, there is a flash of light. To Diamond's surprise, he is stopped in place. He looks down to see himself in a [[Reg|Regigigas]]'s grasp. As the others stare in shock, Cynthia mentions that she saw the Regigigas appear from Platinum's bag. Regigigas gently sets Diamond and Moo on the ground, and as Platinum and Pearl try to figure out if the massive Pokémon is a friend or a foe, a voice chimes in to confirm that it's here to help. Dr. Footstep is shown, revealed to have been reading Regigigas's footprint. He says that from the footprint, he can tell that it is willing to do everything it can to fight for Sinnoh. ==Major events== * Time and Space begin to distort all around [[Sinnoh]], causing people to end up in a different, random location. * {{adv|Looker}} attempts to interrogate the two {{tc|Scientist}}s from [[Lake Valor]] while [[Dr. Footstep]] ends up at the [[Spear Pillar]]. * {{adv|Diamond}} returns {{TP|Fantina|Drifblim}} to [[Fantina]]. * A black hole begins to suck everyone in the [[Spear Pillar]] into it. * Diamond attempts to stop the black hole by himself, but is saved by [[Reg|Regigigas]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * {{adv|Looker}} * [[Bebe]] * [[Hayley]] ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Diamond}} * {{adv|Pearl}} * {{adv|Platinum}} * {{adv|Looker}} * [[Roark]] * [[Gardenia]] * [[Maylene]] * [[Crasher Wake]] * [[Fantina]] * [[Candice]] * [[Cynthia]] * [[Cyrus]] * [[Dr. Footstep]] * [[Jordan]] * [[Dexter]] * [[Keira]] * [[Bebe]] * [[Hayley]] * {{tc|Scientist}}s * {{tc|Ranchers|Belle & Pa}} * {{tc|Ninja Boy}} * {{tc|Tuber}} * {{tc|Poké Kid}} * [[Contest announcer]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Lickilicky}} ([[Kit]]/{{tt|Tung|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Mamoswine}} (Moo; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Empoleon}} ({{OP|Platinum|Empoleon}}) * {{p|Croagunk}} ({{OP|Looker|Croagunk}}) * {{p|Drifblim}} ({{OP|Fantina|Drifblim}}; returned) * {{p|Garchomp}} ({{OP|Cynthia|Garchomp}}) * {{p|Honchkrow}} ([[Cyrus]]'s) * {{p|Glameow}} ([[Bebe]]'s) * {{p|Gastrodon}} ({{tc|Ranchers|Pa}}'s; {{form|Gastrodon|East Sea}}) * {{p|Dialga}} ({{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Dialga|Adventures}}) * {{p|Palkia}} ({{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Palkia|Adventures}}) * {{p|Regigigas}} ({{DL|Reg|Adventures}}) * {{p|Gastly}} * {{p|Misdreavus}} * {{p|Steelix}} * {{p|Bidoof}} ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=FFCCCC|bordercolor=9999FF |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 帝牙盧卡 & 帕路奇犽V|VS Dialga & Palkia V}} |fr=Accomplir l'inaccompli |de=VS.
